documentation.content: Runbook row: Job failure and missed schedule (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan; coordinated with RECOVERY-RETENTION.md's c369 alerting requirement). Responder: on-call API responder. One condition: a chirp-purge execution that completes with a result other than succeeded, in a 5-minute window. It can fire only for an execution that writes run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count. An execution that fails before any task starts writes no point: from Aug 26 to Sep 13 2026 every scheduled chirp-purge run failed that way, denied access to its database secret, and this metric recorded nothing, so this condition could not fire. Silence from this policy therefore does not prove the job ran or succeeded. Failures before a task starts, and runs that never start at all, are board card c410. The missed-schedule conditionAbsent was removed in c407: the API rejects an absence duration over 23h30m, which is shorter than this job's daily cadence (schedule '0 9 * * *' UTC in infra/monitoring/evidence/c398-scheduler-chirp-purge-daily-2026-09-10.json), and the raw error is in infra/monitoring/evidence/c407-live-create-errors-2026-09-13.json. Do not re-add it. The 5-minute evaluation window is a judgment call, not a runbook-stated number. Initial, review after 7 days.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.job_name="chirp-purge" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result!="succeeded"
